time.desc: One party filed a civil lawsuit against another party on the grounds of "sexual harassment infringement" and the case was formally filed by the court, and the dispute entered the substantive trial process.
This civil dispute over sexual harassment infringement has entered the stage of awaiting judgment after several closed court hearings.

A page appeared on the code hosting platform that publicly collated and disclosed the personal information and academic connections of the parties involved, and the controversy spilled over into an "open box" network mobilization incident.

The court made a first-instance judgment on the "sexual harassment infringement" dispute, finding that the existing evidence was insufficient to confirm sexual harassment and rejected the plaintiff's application

A relative of one party filed a civil lawsuit against the university over previous disciplinary sanctions and reputational damage, requesting the university to revoke the sanctions and issue a public apology and compensation.
The university involved issued a response stating that it respected the judicial conclusion and launched a special investigation and review of disciplinary sanctions and academic integrity issues.
Public opinion platforms announced permanent bans on accounts that pretend to be relevant identities and spread false information to curb rumors.
After losing the first instance, the prosecutor filed an appeal and the appeal was accepted by the second instance court, and the case entered the second instance procedure.
